$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — LLM commander L-1 (CE-4676, docs/designs/llm-commander/DESIGN_LLM_Commander.md §1, §11): the Platoon's brain is a seat with the SCRIPTED mind; Alpha Squad and Bravo Squad fight with the game AI; Red's Defenders hold the sheds. FEATURE scenario (no golden until two fresh runs agree, §5). The 'report' cue reads the brain node's report log (editor tier). Measured outcome (2026-11-22, two runs): Red engages at once, Alpha is out of the fight at ~18 s and Bravo breaks contact to 'start' — the fight ends by breaking contact (handoff check ④'s second branch).

expect.name: both squads are sent to the objective at the start
a squad attacks within 1 s of the first SPOT into the platoon
